messages.content: What parameters do the viscous friction force depend on, and in which case should it be taken into account for the physical pendulum model? In your response the last word of each sentence must become the first word of the next sentence.

message.content:
Viscous friction force depends on angular velocity and damping coefficient.
coefficient values depend on fluid viscosity, contact area, and geometry.
geometry sets the damping torque in the physical pendulum model.
model should include it when damping is not negligible.
